messages:
maria: Quick sync — customer A reported rerank drift after a dimension bump. We need a short PRD + rollout + rollback criteria for switching embeddings from 768 -> 1024. No downtime, must keep rerank stable. Meeting tomorrow 10am?

raj: ack, I'll draft a lean PRD in-thread so we can iterate.

raj: PRD draft bullets:
- goal: upgrade embed dim to 1024 for better recall on long docs
- constraints: zero-downtime for hosted API; private deploys can be scheduled
- success metric: NDCG@10 drop <= 0.02 offline, live top-10 stability >= 95%
- rollout: shadow -> canary -> gradual traffic -> full
- rollback triggers: NDCG@10 drop > 0.05 OR error rate spike > 0.5% OR latency 95p increase > 200ms

emmie: Important: batcher currently assumes fixed vector size per worker. Mixing old/new dims can cause hang or panics. We need per-worker model pinning + request header to mark schema version, or batcher must validate lengths and reject mismatches.

kai: Proposal: dual-serving during canary: keep embed-768 route and embed-1024 route, route a percent of requests to 1024 for ranking and keep 768 as fallback. Avoid padding/truncation — that shifts semantics. Instead do shadow rerank comparisons and only flip when metrics pass.

sarah-b: Customer requirement: rerank should be stable for top-10 results for 95% of queries. How are we measuring "stable"? I suggest offline pairwise NDCG on recent query set + live shadowing with percent sampling and periodic comparisons.

raj: Acceptance criteria (short):
```
- unit tests: batcher rejects mismatched vector lengths
- offline eval: NDCG@10 drop <= 0.02 vs baseline on holdout set
- shadow period: 24-72h with 10-20% shadowed traffic for canary
- live canary pass: no rollback triggers for 48h at canary weight >= 20%
```

emmie: Also add tests for KV cache compatibility — older KV caches may be incompatible. We should namespace cache keys by model-version and flush caches on switch for shared nodes.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: canary-embed-1024 -> deployment ID canary-20260322-01, window 2026-03-22T09:00Z (ops notified).

kai: Edge-case: requests with batch-level padding (we pad shorter sequences) vs vector padding — make sure batching code distinguishes sequence padding from embedding dimensionality. If batcher allowed variable-length vectors historically, we must forbid it now.

maria: Good catch. Operational checklist to include in PRD:
- PRD + acceptance signoff
- unit/integration tests merged
- offline eval results attached
- canary deployment plan + runbook
- automatic rollback rules configured
- docs for SDK change if header required

sarah-b: Prioritization: customer is pushing; can we fast-track VIP private deployment while hosted goes through gradual rollout? That reduces customer risk.

raj: Yes — we'll treat customer as VIP: private deploy first with dedicated pool and shadow traffic, then hosted canary. I'll add separate rollout schedule in PRD.

emmie: Implementation note: add explicit batcher check in code:
```
if vector_length != expected_dim:
  reject_request(400, "embed-dim-mismatch")
```
Also tests for graceful rejection and metrics emitted.

maria: @kai can you own cache invalidation plan? @emmie can you add batcher tests? I'll own PRD and stakeholder signoff.

kai: taking cache invalidation. Will post design by EOD.

raj: I'll update the PRD with these ACs and a small deploy checklist, then ping for approvals.

maria: thanks — if anyone has objections to the rollback thresholds speak now, otherwise I'll fold these into the PRD and post a link. :thumbsup:

sarah-b: no objections from me. Customer success onboarded.

deploy-bot: ops: canary-20260322-01 created, watchers: @ops, @eng-oncall.
